notes: Restores the full hub in the local app. public/index.html serves two audiences - the local engine (video_server.js serves it for '/') and the desktop app open it directly, while Cloudflare Pages serves the same file as the public website. Trimming the website to just the Mobile Status Viewer had also gutted the local hub. Local-only links are now removed at parse time when the page is not on the local box, so the installed app and LAN show Facilitator Dashboard, TV Display + Video Ads and Mobile Status Viewer, while https://tdqsys.pages.dev/ still shows only the Mobile Status Viewer. Also: /display is a real 404, and a bare /client with no ?id= shows a 'No location selected' panel instead of silently rendering the shared sites/auto-01 record.
